items.title: Blue Ceramic Pie Plate
items.alt: Empty white ceramic pie dish with blue floral decoration resting on folded blue gingham cloth.
items.description: Empty white ceramic pie dish with blue floral decoration resting on folded blue gingham cloth. The open center can hold a short classroom label or sit beside a personal pie recipe heading.

items.title: Pie Server and Fork
items.alt: Wooden-handled triangular pie server and silver fork on a folded burgundy napkin with a few crumbs.
items.description: Wooden-handled triangular pie server and silver fork on a folded burgundy napkin with a few crumbs. Add the serving tools to a personal dessert layout or a classroom utensil vocabulary card.

items.title: Ceramic Pie Bird
items.alt: Glossy black ceramic pie bird with an open beak and hollow base beside small pastry leaves.
items.description: Glossy black ceramic pie bird with an open beak and hollow base beside small pastry leaves. Use the unusual baking tool in a classroom object-matching task or a personal pastry notebook.

items.title: Covered Pie Carrier

items.description: Mint-green round pie carrier with a clear domed lid, top handle and a lattice pie inside. This enclosed carrier suits a personal picnic checklist or a classroom discussion of food containers.

items.title: Windowed Pie Gift Box

items.description: Partly open kraft pie box with a clear round lid window, teal ribbon and a cherry lattice pie inside. Use the gift-style packaging in a personal bake-sharing invitation or a classroom container activity.
